question: The position of how many letters will be changed if each of the letters in the word ACQUIRE is arranged in alphabetical order?
solution:
The position of the letters that will change if each of the letters in the word ACQUIRE is arranged in alphabetical order is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9bdddd4793bcb4b8ae71fddeacdd6eb49a90400050e1966df5dd0e0345c534f6.png] 

The position of four letters change when each of the letters in the word ACQUIRE is arranged in alphabetical order.

Hence, '**Four**' is the correct answer.
